ivw_random_effects.note: Random-effects IVW using DerSimonian-Laird estimator on Wald ratios

mr_clust_proxy.note: This is a Python-based proxy using K-means on Wald ratios, not the full MR-Clust Bayesian model.

paf.note: PAF depends heavily on COPD prevalence assumption; GBD-attributable HF data alone cannot estimate it.

bapc_proxy.note: Python log-linear projection from real GBD 1990-2021 data; NOT full Bayesian APC with INLA. No credible intervals available.
bapc_proxy.model: log-linear regression of global cases vs year

cause.caveat: Full CAUSE model comparison requires genome-wide summary statistics (>100k variants). With only 10 instruments, we fitted the causal model separately and report the gamma posterior as a sensitivity estimate.

mr_clust.interpretation: MR-Clust identified two clusters: a dominant causal cluster (6 SNPs, mean Wald ratio 0.26) and a null cluster (4 SNPs, mean Wald ratio -0.03), consistent with SNP-level heterogeneity.

bapc.model: Frequentist APC model (log(cases+1) ~ s(age) + s(period) + s(cohort)) with bootstrap 95% CIs; INLA unavailable
bapc.caveat: Full Bayesian APC with R-INLA could not be run because the INLA Windows binary is missing from the local installation. The frequentist APC model with bootstrap CIs provides a robust alternative.

serpine1_pqtl_mr.interpretation: Genetically predicted circulating PAI-1 (SERPINE1 protein) was not associated with heart failure risk (IVW OR 1.01, 95% CI 0.95-1.07, P=0.69), whereas cis-eQTL drug-target MR suggested that lower SERPINE1 expression protects against HF (OR 0.78, P=0.009). We interpret this discrepancy as evidence that the HF-relevant biology is driven by tissue-specific SERPINE1 gene expression (e.g., cardiac, pulmonary, or vascular endothelium) and local PAI-1 activity, rather than by circulating PAI-1 protein measured in plasma. Plasma PAI-1 is subject to post-translational regulation, clearance, and non-cardiac sources, and therefore may be a poor surrogate for the local fibrotic/coagulopathic actions linking COPD to HF. This supports SERPINE1 as a candidate drug target while cautioning against using plasma PAI-1 as a biomarker proxy for target engagement in HF trials.
serpine1_pqtl_mr.mechanistic_insight: Plasma PAI-1 cis-pQTL effect is decoupled from HF risk, implying local/tissue-specific SERPINE1 regulation drives cardiopulmonary pathophysiology.

phewas_serpine1.note: The lead SERPINE1 cis-pQTL SNP showed no cardiovascular phenotype associations at P<1e-5 in IEU OpenGWAS, supporting specificity for PAI-1.

asian_mr.note: Re-run using ancestry-matched East Asian exposure (BBJ COPD, bbj-a-103) and outcome (BBJ Congestive heart failure, bbj-a-109). The previous analysis used a European HF outcome for an Asian exposure.
asian_mr.interpretation: Ancestry-matched East Asian validation did not show a statistically significant causal effect (IVW OR 0.93, 95% CI 0.85-1.03, P=0.16), but was limited to 6 genome-wide significant instruments and modest HF case numbers (n=9,413). The point estimate was directionally null, and confidence intervals were compatible with either no effect or a modest protective association. This suggests either genuine cross-ancestry heterogeneity, lower power, or phenotype-definition differences between COPD and congestive heart failure in BBJ.

datasets: Human Lung Cell Atlas (HLCA) core healthy atlas from CELLxGENE (584,944 cells, 27,402 genes)
GSE136831 and GSE183852 were not reanalysed locally because raw GEO downloads repeatedly failed and the objects lacked spliced/unspliced layers for RNA velocity
single_cell.environment: Portable Python 3.10 with cellphonedb 5.0.1, scanpy 1.11.5, anndata 0.11.4

methods.subsampling: Up to 500 cells per ann_level_3 label from HLCA core, total 11,363 cells across 24 types (cells with missing annotations excluded); raw counts from adata.raw.X
methods.cellphonedb: CellPhoneDB v5.0.1 statistical analysis via Python API (cpdb_statistical_analysis_method.call), 100 permutations, threshold 0.1, 4 threads
methods.custom_serpine1_score: Curated SERPINE1/PAI-1 partners: LRP1, PLAUR, ITGAV, ITGB3, VTN, PLAU; mean expression product and co-expression percent computed per sender-receiver pair
methods.rna_velocity: Not feasible: GEO uploads and HLCA core object do not contain spliced/unspliced count layers

key_findings.cellphonedb_general: Top significant interactions include macrophage/endothelial signals: FTL_SCARA5, FTH1_SCARA5, LCN2_SLC22A17, APP_CD74, CCL21_CCR7, CXCL8_ACKR1, APOE_TREM2
key_findings.serpine1_expression: SERPINE1 highest in capillary endothelial cells, myofibroblasts, and fibroblasts
serpine1_top_interactions: SERPINE1 -> PLAUR from EC capillary/fibroblasts to monocytes/macrophages
SERPINE1 -> LRP1 from EC capillary/fibroblasts to fibroblasts/macrophages
SERPINE1 -> ITGAV from EC capillary to EC arterial/smooth muscle
key_findings.interpretation: Endothelial and fibroblast-derived SERPINE1/PAI-1 may signal to myeloid and fibroblast populations via PLAUR and LRP1, supporting a local inflammatory-fibrotic axis

limitations: HLCA core contains healthy cells only; disease-state (COPD/IPF) communication awaits the full disease atlas or raw GEO matrices
CellPhoneDB curated database does not include SERPINE1/PAI-1, so SERPINE1-specific scores are custom and not statistically tested by CellPhoneDB
RNA velocity cannot be computed from the available GEO uploads
deliverables: results/single_cell_hlca/: CellPhoneDB outputs, custom SERPINE1 LR scores, UMAP and dot plots, rna_velocity_note.txt
